title: A remote reading. A very human decision.

slides.headline: Out here, change is quiet.
slides.body: A remote reading can help someone decide what needs a closer look.

slides.headline: Which change needs attention?
slides.body: Define which thresholds matter and how quickly the team needs to know.

slides.headline: Send the part that matters.
slides.body: Design a small, useful exception message and retain detail locally where appropriate.

slides.headline: Remote still has limits.
slides.body: Plan for power and sky view; a satellite path cannot guarantee delivery.

slides.headline: Bring the site into the design.
slides.body: Use the readiness guide to map the site, payload and reporting priorities.

technicalNotes.headline: Remote data still needs a priority
technicalNotes.body: Not every reading needs immediate transmission. Define what changes a decision.

technicalNotes.headline: Design for constrained payloads
technicalNotes.body: Send the smallest useful exception message; retain detail locally where appropriate.

technicalNotes.headline: Account for the site
technicalNotes.body: Sky view, mounting, antenna placement, power and maintenance access affect the design.

technicalNotes.headline: Keep the caveat visible
technicalNotes.body: A satellite layer extends the design; it does not guarantee continuous availability or delivery.

technicalNotes.headline: Define the reporting logic
technicalNotes.body: Bring the site, payload and urgency model to a design review.
